title: Book Three · Chapter 196: Before Her Journey
story:
Near the end of June, Ronan posts his twenty-sixth letter to Leo.

He copies the centre's office address from the arrival sheet. Letters with his full name can wait at the office until he arrives. He has no room number yet.

He gives Leo the July dates and asks about the new shop work. The postage comes from his separate spending money.

Then the first days of July arrive. Anna is leaving before him.

On their last free afternoon before her journey, they walk through the park. She has brought the school-gate drawing in her notebook.

“The original,” she says when he looks at it.

He smiles. “I remember those windows.”

They sit on the low wall. Anna turns the page so he can see the high windows.

Her mother will travel with her on Sunday, before the second Monday in July. They have checked the early bus again. It still leaves at seven and takes about three hours.

Anna has bought her own six-yuan single ticket from her personal savings. Her mother has paid twelve for her own return ticket.

“She will come back that evening,” Anna says.

“And you stay.”

She nods. For a while, they both look at the drawing.

“My mum gave me the first term's three hundred and thirty,” she says. “It is in the study envelope now.”

Ronan closes his hand around hers. Her family's course fund is separate from his own.

“I want to hear about the room,” he says.

“Even the small things?”

“Especially those.”

She smiles and puts the notebook away.

They take the longer path beneath the trees. There is shade on one side and bright summer light on the other.

At the far bench, Anna stops. Ronan turns toward her, and she puts both arms around him.

He holds her for a long quiet moment. He rests his cheek against her hair and closes his eyes.

“I'm excited,” she says against his shoulder.

“I know.”

“And sad.”

“Me too.”

She looks up, and he kisses her. When they move apart, she keeps one hand on his shirt.

“Sunday morning?” she asks.

“I will be at the station before the bus.”

She nods. They walk back to the gate together, still holding hands.

At the road, Anna takes her notebook home. Ronan watches until she reaches the corner, then goes back to the green door to check his own later arrival date.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

single ticket＝单程票；room number＝房间号码；original＝原稿；shade＝树荫、阴凉处。

## 理解问题

1. Anna和母亲各买了什么票？谁留下、谁回家，第一学期三百三十元由谁交给谁？
2. 第二十六封信有没有虚构房号或让Leo瞬移？两人怎样同时表达期待和难过？

## 读句子

**She has brought the school-gate drawing in her notebook.**

拆开看：She / has brought / the school-gate drawing / in her notebook.

她／带来了／旧学校大门的画／夹在自己的本子里。
